results.description:
Ann Cleeves Classic Crime - engaging mysteries to savour, beloved characters to meet again

Sea Fever is the sixth mystery novel featuring George and Molly Palmer-Jones by Ann Cleeves, author of the Shetland and Vera Stanhope crime series.

Former detective George Palmer-Jones is on a birdwatching trip to Cornwall, having been hired by the anxious parents of Greg Franks, who want their errant son returned home.

For George, who might have otherwise turned the case down flat, the offer of a free week’s birdwatching is too tempting to resist. But when a rare and unrecorded sea bird captures all the birders’ attention, the unthinkable happens and Greg, the most fanatical birder of them all, disappears from right under their noses.

When his corpse, the head bludgeoned, is found floating in the sea, George must unhappily shoulder the burden of finding out why the young man has been murdered.

Who hated Greg enough to kill him? Almost everyone, it seems . . .

Sea Fever is the sixth mystery in the George and Molly Palmer-Jones series, following Another Man's Poison. It is followed by Mill on the Shore.

Praise for Ann Cleeves:

'Everything Ann Cleeves writes is incredible' – Richard Osman, author of The Thursday Murder Club

'Ann Cleeves is a stone-cold genius' – Marian Keyes, author of My Favourite Mistake

'The Queen of the detective novel, thrilling millions of readers' – Daily Express
